metadata.source: Microsoft Defender XDR/Lateral Movement/Suspicious RDP Lateral Movement Activity.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description:
Detects potential lateral movement activity through Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP)
using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint remote session enrichment fields.
The rule identifies remote source devices or IP addresses generating RDP-originated
activity across multiple target systems within a one-hour period. This behavior
may indicate compromised administrator credentials, unauthorized remote access,
human-operated ransomware activity, or attacker lateral movement inside the environment.
The detection leverages the following RDP session enrichment fields:
- IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession
- InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP
- InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName
The rule focuses on identifying RDP fan-out behavior where a single remote source
accesses multiple devices within a short timeframe.
properties.query:
let DeviceThreshold = 3;
let AllowedSubnets =
  toscalar(
      _GetWatchlist('RDPAllowedSubnets')
      | summarize make_list(SearchKey)
  );
DeviceProcessEvents
| where IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession == true
| where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP)
// Exclude watchlist subnets
| where not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP, AllowedSubnets))
| summarize
    TargetDeviceCount = dcount(DeviceName),
    TargetDevices = make_set(DeviceName, 20),
    TotalEvents = count(),
    AccountsUsed = make_set(AccountName, 20),
    ProcessesExecuted = make_set(FileName, 20)
    by
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP,
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName
| where TargetDeviceCount >= DeviceThreshold
| project
    Timestamp = now(),
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP,
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName,
    TargetDeviceCount,
    TotalEvents,
    AccountsUsed,
    ProcessesExecuted,
    TargetDevices
| order by TargetDeviceCount desc
